characteristicScore.description: The linked characteristic value (one of: fortitudo, celeritas, gratia, mens, prudentia, audacia).

diceCount.description: Number of d6 chosen by the player (risk betting). Minimum 2. Untrained characters are limited to exactly 2.

grade.description: Effective grade points for die value reduction. May include combined maneuver grades.

extraDice.description: Number of extra dice from focus, fama, talents, items. Each grants one discard.

successBonus.description: Positive modifier applied to final successes.

successPenalty.description: Negative modifier applied to final successes.

difficultyThreshold.description: If set, finalSuccesses must meet or exceed this value to pass.

opposedSuccesses.description: If set, opponent's final successes for opposed resolution.

diceRolled.description: Pre-rolled dice results. Length must equal diceCount + extraDice. The engine is deterministic; rolling is external.

discardIndices.description: Player-chosen indices of dice to discard. Length must not exceed extraDice (player may keep extra dice when sum fits). If null, smart auto-discard: keep all when sum fits, otherwise discard highest non-1 values first stopping as soon as sum fits.

pipeline.name: validateInput
pipeline.description: Assert diceCount >= 2. If untrained (grade == 0 and no extraDice from skill sources), enforce diceCount == 2. Assert diceRolled.length == diceCount + extraDice. Assert all dice values in [1,6]. If discardIndices provided, assert discardIndices.length <= extraDice and all indices are valid.

pipeline.name: rollDice
pipeline.description: Accept diceRolled as input. Store copy as diceOriginal. Passthrough in deterministic engine; actual rolling is delegated to the adapter layer.

pipeline.name: applyExtraDiceDiscards
pipeline.description: Optionally remove up to extraDice dice from working set. If discardIndices provided, remove those specific indices (may be fewer than extraDice). If null, smart auto-discard: if total sum already fits characteristic score, keep all dice (maximizes 1s count); otherwise discard highest non-1 values first, stopping as soon as sum fits. Store result as diceAfterDiscards.
pipeline.edgeCase: If all dice are discarded (diceAfterDiscards is empty), sum = 0, roll-under automatically passes, onesCount = 0, basePassed = true, rawSuccesses = 1.

pipeline.name: applyGradeReductions
procedure: While gradesRemaining > 0 AND there exists a die with value > 1:
Select the die with the minimum value among dice > 1.
Repeat until gradesRemaining == 0 OR all dice == 1.
pipeline.rationale: Each grade reduces total sum by 1 regardless of which die is chosen. Since extra successes come from dice showing 1, it is always optimal to reduce the lowest die greater than 1 first to maximize the number of dice that reach 1.

outputFields.diceAfterReduction: Final die values after all grade points applied.
outputFields.gradesUsed: Number of grade points actually consumed.
outputFields.gradesRemaining: Leftover grade points (when all dice are already 1).

pipeline.name: computeSuccesses
logic: If basePassed: rawSuccesses = 1 + count(die == 1 in diceAfterReduction).
The fail gate blocks ALL successes including those from dice showing 1.

outputFields.onesCount: Count of dice showing 1 (informational even if basePassed is false).

pipeline.name: applyModifiers
pipeline.description: Modifiers are applied to final successes, not to the dice roll. Successes cannot go below 0.

pipeline.name: evaluateDifficulty
pipeline.logic: If difficultyThreshold is set: difficultyPassed = (finalSuccesses >= difficultyThreshold). Else: difficultyPassed = null.

pipeline.name: evaluateOpposed
pipeline.logic: If opposedSuccesses is set: netSuccesses = finalSuccesses - opposedSuccesses. Else: netSuccesses = null.

diceOriginal.description: All dice as rolled, before any processing.

diceAfterDiscards.description: Dice remaining after extra dice discards.

characteristicScore.description: Echo of input characteristic for display.

onesCount.description: Count of dice showing 1 in diceAfterReduction.

rawSuccesses.description: 1 + onesCount if basePassed, else 0. Before modifiers.

edgeCases.name: allDiceDiscarded
edgeCases.condition: extraDice >= diceCount, causing diceAfterDiscards to be empty.
edgeCases.behavior: finalSum = 0, basePassed = true (0 <= any characteristic), onesCount = 0, rawSuccesses = 1.

edgeCases.name: untrainedCheck
edgeCases.condition: Skill grade == 0 and no skill-sourced extraDice.
edgeCases.behavior: diceCount is forced to exactly 2. Validator rejects diceCount != 2.

edgeCases.name: combinedManeuver
edgeCases.condition: Player activates a combined maneuver with a correlated skill.
edgeCases.behavior: effectiveGrade = gradeBase + gradeCorrelated. Spirito cost (1 point) is deducted by the adapter, not the engine. In initiative contexts, costs 3 Riflessi.

edgeCases.name: allDiceAlreadyOne
edgeCases.condition: All dice in diceAfterDiscards are already 1 before grade reduction.
edgeCases.behavior: Grade reduction terminates immediately. gradesUsed = 0, gradesRemaining = grade.

edgeCases.name: gradesExceedReducibleTotal
edgeCases.condition: grade > sum(die - 1 for die in diceAfterDiscards where die > 1).
edgeCases.behavior: All dice reduced to 1, remaining grades unused. gradesRemaining captures leftover.

edgeCases.name: valoreActivation
edgeCases.condition: Player spends 3 Spirito to invoke a Valore after rolling.
edgeCases.behavior: Only available if basePassed == true. Adds the Valore score to successBonus. Adapter must gate on basePassed before adding to engine input.
edgeCases.ambiguityNote: PDF says activation only after passing roll-under. JSON spec modifier pipeline is unconditional. Adapter must enforce the gate.

edgeCases.name: spiritoForPenaltyCancellation
edgeCases.condition: Player spends Spirito to ignore wound/fatigue penalties.
edgeCases.behavior: Each Spirito point cancels 1 point of successPenalty. Adapter adjusts successPenalty before calling engine.

preEngineSteps.action: Resolve skill from actor.system.skills[skillId]. Get characteristicKey and grade.
Validate Spirito costs: combinedManeuver=1, valore=3, penaltyCancellation=N. Total must not exceed actor.system.resources.spirito.current.

Compute totalPenalty = woundPenalty + fatiguePenalty + encumbrancePenalty + additionalPenalty + (skill.armorPenalized ? max(0, armorProtezione - armorPregiReduction_for_skill) : 0) - spiritoForPenaltyCancellation. Floor at 0. Note: encumbrancePenalty is independent from armorSkillPenalty and they stack.
Roll (diceCount + effectiveExtraDice)d6 via Foundry Roll API.
Call EngineCore.resolve() with: characteristicScore, diceCount, effectiveGrade, effectiveExtraDice, additionalBonus, totalPenalty, diceRolled, discardIndices, difficultyThreshold, opposedSuccesses.
If useValore and engine result basePassed == true: re-invoke engine modifier step with successBonus += valoreScore. If basePassed == false, valore not activated, refund Spirito cost.

postEngineSteps.action: Deduct all Spirito costs from actor (combined maneuver, valore if activated, penalty cancellation).
If in initiative context: deduct Riflessi costs (3 for combined maneuver).
Construct chat card data from engine output.
Create Foundry ChatMessage with roll and rendered template.

entries.ambiguityNote: PDF says 'scartare un risultato a scelta' (discard a result of choice). sword-system.md says 'normalmente il piu alto' (normally the highest). The spec says 'Player may discard one rolled die per extra die' without mandating which. Implementation: player-chosen with auto-highest as default strategy.

entries.rule: If all dice are discarded, automatic base success (sum = 0 <= characteristic)

sources.text: If all dice are discarded, sum = 0, thus roll-under automatically passes and grants base success.

entries.rule: Grade reduction strategy for reducing die values

sources.text: reduceLowestNonOneFirst: Select the die with the minimum value among dice > 1. Reduce that die by 1.
Strategia ottimale suggerita: 1. Ordinare i dadi in ordine decrescente. 2. Ridurre prima i valori piu alti. 3. Portare i dadi a 1 quando possibile.
PDF does not specify an explicit algorithmic ordering for grade allocation. Player examples show grades being applied but do not mandate a specific selection order.

entries.conflictDescription: sword-system.md specifies 'reduce highest first' (sort descending, iterate top-down). sword-check-spec.json specifies 'reduceLowestNonOneFirst' (always pick minimum value > 1). Both reduce total sum by the same amount, but produce different 1-distributions. Example: dice=[4,3,2], grades=4. JSON spec -> [3,1,1] with 2 ones. sword-system.md -> [1,2,2] with 1 one. The JSON spec strategy maximizes dice reaching 1, thus maximizing additional successes. It is strictly optimal for the player.
entries.resolution: JSON spec is authoritative per compiler rules. Engine uses reduceLowestNonOneFirst.

entries.rule: Currency: 1 Lira = 20 Soldi = 240 Denari. Denomination encodes rarity.
Six quality tiers (Scadente through Straordinaria) with cost multipliers, pregi slots, and skill gear bonuses.
Encumbrance base = Fortitudo + grades(Forza). Categories: Leggero (x2, 0), Moderato (x4, -1), Pesante (x6, -2), Massimo (x8, -3). Penalty to all checks AND Movement.
Weapon item type with category, skill, hands, cost, weight, damage (value+type), parry, misura, pregi, ranged stats.
Shield item type. Requires Armi da guerra grade >= 1 for free parry per turn.
Armor item type with protezione (1-3), robustezza (protezione * 10). Each damage absorbed reduces robustezza by 1; every 10 lost = -1 protezione.
Armor protezione is penalty on armorPenalized skills. Four armor pregi (agile, da_arciere, da_geniere, furtiva) each reduce penalty by 2 (min 0) for their specific skill.
entries.note: Resolves AMB-003. The armor penalty formula is now fully specified: armorSkillPenalty = max(0, protezione - armorPregiReduction_for_skill).
